items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Yeah, he was with, Pat was with me for ages.

ctx.x: Yeah, I just didn't know you worked with him.

Yeah, he was with, Pat was with me for ages. In fact, I got, I got, I made Henry Newfield a leader at the Court of the Two Sisters. Joe Fine is a very dear friend of mine. I've known Joe all my life almost. And I was his music advisor down at the, at the, at the Court of the Two Sisters. Uh-huh. And, uh, he needed a band. So I asked Henry if he wanted to work on it. And he got, he got that little, the barber, the piano player. And, uh, he had Pat on bass. He was, I don't remember who played trumpet with him. But,…
What did you call him, uh, that plays piano? From across the river? Valentino, Valentino.

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Pat Easterling, Ray and Frank. I didn't expect to lose Frank so soon.

ctx.x: Would you believe that? We don't belong to the union. But this is something that little Ray Vanitas. He could, he could remind you of things like that. This is one thing we used to talk about. Ray was a very dear friend of mine. And I sure hated to lose him. I hated to lose my other old boy. I think I have a bad luck with baseball is. Really? I lost three. Three. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Pat Easterling, Ray and Frank. I didn't expect to lose Frank so soon. Ray rang up my wife, she used to talk to my wife and…
Wow. Oh. What about dance halls around Elysian Fields? Do you remember that?
